why: Серия «Вопрос мастеру», механика трансформации перил (6,9 млн просмотров у донора). Цель — охват на главной теме балкона.
rules: Roman Group (ArtVitrage) works ONLY with glass. Main product (about 2 of 3 videos): frameless glazing of balconies and verandas (windows for balconies), pergolas, balcony blinds. Also: stained glass, decorative mirrors, glass kitchen backsplashes (skinali), glass partitions. EVERY shot must clearly show glass work as the main subject. Forbidden shots: kitchens or rooms where cabinets, appliances or furniture are the subject and no glass is clearly visible in focus; furniture or cabinets being built or assembled; woodwork; drinking glasses, glassware, bottles or jars; tiles, plaster or other trades; mosques, churches and religious images (synagogue stained glass only from his own photos). Never mention furniture. No prices, no deadlines, no client names, no other companies' objects.

problems: Frames at 5.8s and 4.5s are near-identical exterior shots of the building, a static repeat
Frames at 7.1s and 8.4s are near-identical, the same man with a thumbs-up, so the video drags
Frame at 1.9s and 3.2s repeat the same dark balcony window with autumn leaves; glass is barely visible and the shot is dark and dim
Caption at 0.6s covers the glass and the couple; the text is cluttered at the top
The man's face sits right in the frame and the glass work is not the main subject, so the picture does not show wind protection
qa.fix: Replace the repeated dark window and building frames with close, bright shots of a railing being turned into frameless glass (before/after, glass panels sliding), cut the duplicate thumbs-up shot to one, and end on a glass balcony with the WhatsApp call to action.
